original:
It
readily follows from Figure 5 that $\#E=qr+2q$ ,
 $\#V=2q+2$ and so the total of linearly independent cycles is

 $qr+2q-(2q+2)+1=qr-1,$ 

which matches the genus of the curve (see [1, Theorem 4.1]).
